2  These applications coming on for admission this day, t  the following:
 ORDER These are first bail applications filed by applicants Pawan @ Bablu and Hanmat Singh, under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, for grant of regular bail to applicants who are in custody since 24.4.2023 relating to FIR No.95/2022, registered at Police Station-Raneh, District-Damoh (MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 416, 417, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 and 120- B/34 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicants submitted that there is compromise between the parties and land has also been given to complainant Rahul Singh in proceedings of Lok Adalat.
In these circumstances, applicants may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5 . Considering the facts of the case, bail applications filed by the applicants are allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicants shall be released on bail on each of them furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

7 . In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicants shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE mms Hanmat Singh (Wrongly Mentioned In The ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103490741/
